legacy.name: argon2id defaults
legacy.note: Argon2id via libsodium's internal argon2id_hash_raw: salt = type string + recipe, lanes 1, 2 passes, 64 MiB. The port throws unsupportedHashFunction.

legacy.name: argon2id lengthInBytes 8
legacy.note: Output shorter than Argon2's 16-byte minimum is the first 8 bytes of the 16-byte hash.

legacy.name: argon2id lengthInBytes 96
legacy.note: Output longer than 64 bytes exercises Argon2's variable-length H' construction.

legacy.name: argon2id password
legacy.note: Argon2id feeding the password word selection.

legacy.name: lengthInBytes fractional
legacy.note: nlohmann truncated 16.9 to 16. The port throws wrongType.

legacy.name: lengthInBytes boolean
legacy.note: nlohmann read true as 1. The port throws wrongType.

legacy.name: lengthInBytes 0
legacy.note: An empty secret. The port throws outOfRange.

legacy.name: lengthInChars 0
legacy.note: An empty password (upstream issue 56). The port throws outOfRange.

legacy.name: issue 56 seed
legacy.note: The original issue 56 vector, kept for the app's PasswordDerivationTests until the port lands.

legacy.name: unknown wordList
legacy.note: Fell back to the 512 list. The port throws unknownWordList.

legacy.name: inverted bits and words check accepts a wrong pair
legacy.note: Accepted because 9 == ceil(1 * 9); lengthInWords wins. The port throws bitsAndWordsConflict.

legacy.name: duplicate lengthInBytes
legacy.note: nlohmann kept the last value. The port throws duplicateField.

legacy.name: key algorithm on a Secret
legacy.note: Tolerated, forcing lengthInBytes 32. The port throws invalidAlgorithm.

legacy.name: unknown algorithm on a Password
legacy.note: Any unknown algorithm was ignored on a Password. The port throws invalidAlgorithm.

legacy.name: lengthInBytes 8192 past the HKDF limit
legacy.note: The one-byte HKDF counter wrapped after 255 blocks. The port allows at most 8160.

legacy.name: lengthInWords 1021 past the HKDF limit
legacy.note: 8168 bytes of words. The port allows at most 1020 words.

legacy.name: lengthInBytes above 32 bits
legacy.note: Truncated to 32 bits, so 16. The port throws outOfRange.
